 ^0000FF 1 Cactus Needle ^000000 for sewing,

scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
天哪。你的歌声太美妙了！！太好了！！！
我本来打算把这些
送给孩子们的，但既然你找到了
我的乐谱，还为我唱了颂歌！

scripts.text:
-She brought a big sack-
-and opened it in front of you-
scripts.translation:
-她拿出一个大袋子-
-在你面前打开它-

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
OK! Don't look inside.
Just put your hands
grab what you want.
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
好了！不要看里面。
把手伸进去，
抓住你想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Cookie Bag!
I wrapped those indivisually.
There are many sweets in them.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
饼干袋子！
这些是单独包装的。
里面有很多糖果。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Candies!
These were made by
Chief noun.
Very sweet and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
糖果！
这些是首领制作的。
非常甜美可口。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Candy Canes!
These were made by
Chief noun.
Very sweet and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
拐杖糖！
这些是首领制作的。
非常甜美可口。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Piece Of Cake!
These were baked by
Chief Acolyte.
Very soft and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
小蛋糕！
这些是服事制作的。
非常松软可口。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Cookies!
These were baked by
Chief Acolyte.
Very crispy and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
饼干！
这些是服事制作的。
非常酥脆可口。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Spore Doll!
It's made elaborately by
Bishop, Tomas.
Very cute.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
魔菇娃娃！
这是托马主教精心制作的。
非常可爱。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Baphomet Doll!
..........?!..........
How did it get in here..?!
Oops, oh well.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
巴风特娃娃！
..........?!..........
它怎么会在里面..?!
哎呀，算了。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:

Oops, oh well.
Merry Christmas!

..........?!..........

哎呀，算了。

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Rocker Doll!
This was donated by
a knight, Lighten.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
摇滚蝗虫娃娃！
这是骑士Lighten捐赠的。
他真好心。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Yoyo Doll!
This was donated by
an assassin, Marzia.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
溜溜猴娃娃！
这是刺客Marzia捐赠的。
他真好心。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Racoon Doll!
This was donated by
a hunter, Raiden Kurs.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
浣熊娃娃！
这是猎人Raiden Kurs捐赠的。
他真好心。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Black Cat Doll!
Sister Magareta found the item
from the monster, Loli Ruri.
Very kind of her.
Hope she is doing okay.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
黑猫娃娃！
玛格丽特修女从萝莉·露莉身上
捡到了这个物品。
她真好心。
希望她一切都好。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Hung Doll!
I made this doll.
Isn't it adorable?!
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
吊颈娃娃！
这是我做的娃娃。
是不是很可爱？！
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Munak Doll!
That is from some country
across the ocean.
An artisan made this doll
with his passion.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
僵尸娃娃！
这是来自大洋彼岸的某个国家。
一位工匠倾注了热情制作了它。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Santa Hat!
This is only produced
during Christmas season.
It is not a common hat.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
圣诞帽！
这只在圣诞季才会出现。
它不是普通的帽子。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Welcome back!! You look good.
2 arms and 2 legs, you look great.
But, where is my music book?!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
欢迎回来！！你看起来不错。
两只手两条腿，看起来很棒。
但是，我的乐谱在哪里？！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Thank you very much.
People and even Devils are
all excited on Christmas day,
so nobody knows what would
happen. Will you help me
then, won't you? Please~
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
非常感谢。
人们甚至恶魔在圣诞节都很兴奋，
所以谁也不知道会发生什么。
那么，你会帮我的，对吧？拜托了~

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Let's think about the neighbors
and do a good deed during Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
让我们为邻居着想，在圣诞节行善吧！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Heyhey, human!!
Don't ya wanna sell your
soul and be bound in a beneficial contract with me?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嘿，人类！！
你不想出卖灵魂，
和我签订一份有利的契约吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, you! Deviruchi!!!
What a brat!!! Gotcha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你！小恶魔！！！
真是个坏蛋！！！抓住了！

scripts.text:
-You quickly snatched-
-the nape of Deviruchi's neck-
scripts.translation:
-你迅速抓住了-
-小恶魔的后颈-

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
What are you doing!?
Human?
Let go of me...right now!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
你在干什么！？
人类？
放开我...马上！

scripts.text:
-Deviruchi quickly ran away-
-^4d4dffWhere Deviruchi is gone,-
-there is a worn out paper.^000000-
-Let's read the paper.-
scripts.translation:
-小恶魔迅速跑开了-
-^4d4dff小恶魔消失的地方，-
-有一张破旧的纸。^000000-
-让我们读读这张纸。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rudolph... If... Foggy...
Sledge... Reindeer...
Hmm, I think I got what I need.
Let's go back to Ms.Oholy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鲁道夫...如果...雾...
雪橇...驯鹿...
嗯，我想我找到我需要的了。
让我们回到奥霍利女士那里。
